concepts.label: A — Co-pilot
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: macOS app icon concept for MacClaude, a small native account switching utility. Primary request: design an original space pilot fox mascot, friendly, capable, quietly charming, suitable for a polished desktop productivity app. Single square icon image, not a presentation sheet. Center a large front-facing fox head with clear triangular fox ears, warm orange fur rendered as smooth simplified forms, ivory cheek wedges, a small charcoal nose and alert friendly dark eyes. Spaceflight pilot helmet in warm ivory with a short dark visor raised above the eyes and one understated headset earpiece / short microphone, tiny flight collar only. The fox face remains the main recognition element. Style: beautifully sculpted soft 3D macOS icon, restrained satin ceramic materials and rounded geometry, no individual hairs, tactile but simple. Existing brand colors to preserve: warm terracotta #AA513D, peach #E4A17E and ivory #FFFBF0; charcoal only for facial contrast and visor. Backdrop: softly rounded square tile with warm peach-to-terracotta subtle gradient and gentle dimensional rim, matching that palette. Composition: entire icon tile about 82 percent of square canvas, centered with generous transparent outer margins and a subtle contact shadow; mascot fills the tile boldly, optically centered and recognizable at 32px. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, spacecraft, starfield, accessories unrelated to piloting, mockup environment, or extra icons. True alpha transparency outside tile. Make this feel like a distinctive premium app icon, with calm friendliness rather than a toy or aggressive gaming mascot.

concepts.label: B — Orbital
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: macOS app icon / scalable identity concept for MacClaude. Primary request: an original fox space-pilot emblem, designed as a beautifully simple recognizable mark that can later reduce to a monochrome menu-bar icon. Single square image showing one icon only. Main subject: a large fox head in three-quarter profile looking slightly upward, a strong pointed ear silhouette, tapered fox muzzle, ivory cheek, terracotta face, and a minimal ivory space-pilot helmet curve with one simple circular communications earpiece. A short clear visor edge suggests spaceflight while leaving the fox's face readable. Construct the mascot from about six bold interlocking curved shapes with purposeful negative space; no tiny mechanical detail, fur lines or thin outlines. Expression intelligent, relaxed, approachable. Style: refined flat graphic symbol with just a subtle raised enamel feel; confident silhouette, balanced asymmetry, no sporty crest or badge frame. Brand palette comes from existing warm icon: fox in terracotta #AA513D / peach #E4A17E and ivory #FFFBF0; tile is deep warm charcoal suggesting space, contrasting cleanly with ivory helmet. Backdrop: gently rounded macOS square with subtle depth and soft rim. Composition: tile about 82 percent of square canvas, centered with ample transparent outer margins, understated shadow, large central mark legible at tiny scale. No text, typography, numbers, watermarks, orbit rings, stars, planets, rockets, slogans, grids, extra icons or presentation scene. True transparent alpha outside the tile. Original minimalist mascot identity, not generic esports logo.

concepts.label: C — Explorer
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: macOS app icon concept for MacClaude with potential as a larger in-app mascot. Primary request: create an original charming space explorer fox pilot. Single square app icon, one subject only. A large three-quarter-view orange fox head and minimal shoulder collar in a retro-futurist ivory space helmet with a beautifully clear bubble visor. Preserve two distinctive triangular fox ears inside the helmet silhouette, broad cream muzzle and cheeks, small dark nose, relaxed curious eyes; slight head tilt conveys a resourceful companion. Glass has only one broad soft highlight; face completely visible. No fluffy fur rendering: simple confident sculpted curves. Style: sophisticated soft 3D illustration with satin ivory shell and smooth terracotta-orange fox, warmth and wit, fine editorial character design, not a plush toy, not an aggressive gamer mascot. Existing palette: warm terracotta #AA513D, peach #E4A17E and ivory #FFFBF0, with small charcoal details. Backdrop: softly rounded warm ivory macOS tile with subtle cream bevel and soft shadows. The warm orange fox is the visual focus. Composition: full tile about 82 percent of square canvas, centered, transparent outside tile, mascot large and bold, strong silhouette, no cut-off ears or helmet, subtle grounded shadow. Keep detail minimal for Dock legibility. No text, lettering, numerals, stars, starfield, spacecraft, props, extra characters, watermark, mockup environment, or additional icons. True alpha transparency beyond tile.
